text: {"lessons":["My account declined while I made no trades; in future reviews, I should check whether my holdings still fit my plan rather than letting inaction decide for me.","I should judge each stock by its prospects and role in my portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my average cost.","A recent price move does not predict the next one, so I should make deliberate decisions using a consistent plan instead of reacting to short-term fluctuations."]}
